- memory_id "1000287" [decision]: For anything related to the Ember team, page Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)

- memory_id "1000134": The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)

- memory_id "1000177" [constraint]: The job scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000227": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change, and the Boreal team noticed and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000292" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000107" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000258" [decision]: Lena takes the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-03-17, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000183": The job scheduler needs the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000246": The ledger service depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, authentication gateway)
